fn IsPowerOfTwo(n: Int) -> Bool
  requires (n == n)
  ensures (result == (if (n <= 0) then false else if (n == 1) then true else if ((n % 2) == 1) then false else IsPowerOfTwo((n / 2))))
  effects pure
  example (IsPowerOfTwo(0) == false)
  example (IsPowerOfTwo(1) == true)
{
  if (n <= 0) then false else if (n == 1) then true else if ((n % 2) == 1) then false else IsPowerOfTwo((n / 2))
}

fn solve(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  ensures if ((n % 2) == 1) then (result == ((n - 1) / 2)) else exists z in 1..(n + 1): (((IsPowerOfTwo(z) and (z <= n)) and ((z * 2) > n)) and (result == ((n - z) / 2)))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0) == 0)
